name: NewFile
description: Represents items listed on the New Item task pane available in several Microsoft Office applications.
remarks: Use the Application property or the Creator property to access the NewFile object in each of the applications.
example:
Sub AddNewDocToTaskPane()
    Application.NewDocument.Add FileName:="C:\NewDocument.doc", _
        Section:=msoNew, DisplayName:="New Document"
    CommandBars("Task Pane").Visible = True
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the NewFile object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the NewFile object was created. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(FileName As String, [Section As Variant], [DisplayName As Variant], [Action As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Adds a new item to the New Item task pane. Returns a Boolean value to indicate whether the operation was successful.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the file to add to the list of files on the task pane.

parameters.name: Section
parameters.description: The section to which to add the file. Can be any msoFileNew constant.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The text to display in the task pane.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: The action to take when a user clicks the item. Can be any msoFileNew constant.

methods.name: Remove
methods.signature: Remove(FileName As String, [Section As Variant], [DisplayName As Variant], [Action As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Removes an item from the New Item task pane. Returns a Boolean value to indicate whether the operation was successful.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the file reference.

parameters.name: Section
parameters.description: The section of the task pane where the file reference exists. Can be any msoFileNew constant.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display text of the file reference.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: The action to take when a user clicks the item. Can be any msoFileNew constant.
